entities.summary: Peter Bramall, stage name Bram Tchaikovsky, is a British vocalist and guitarist from Lincolnshire. He was a member of The Motors from 1977 to 1978. His solo career included the album Strange Man, Changed Man and the single "Girl of My Dreams", which peaked in the top 40 in American charts in 1979. Bram Tchaikovsky was a composers & musicians from Lincolnshire (b. 1950-11-10, Lincolnshire). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
